rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a material structural template: a proclamation recites the legal and procedural basis for regulations developed outside the presidential text, reproduces those detailed regulations within the instrument, and concludes by presidentially approving and proclaiming them. The child uses substantially the same proclamation-plus-annex machinery for internationally approved collision regulations, although its operative authority and subject differ. C17 has nearly identical machinery but is earlier and appears to be the foundation for C09, making C09 the more proximate template. C11 also incorporates appended regulatory schedules, but its quota-setting machinery is less closely parallel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim the said Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1948, as set forth in section 6 of the said act, as amended, which are attached hereto and made a part hereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby approve and proclaim the foregoing amendments
shared_material.explanation: Both use a presidential proclamation to give effect to a detailed body of regulations reproduced or incorporated into the proclamation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas certain regulations ... were approved by the International Conference ...; and Whereas by the act ... the Congress ... has authorized the President ... to proclaim the said regulations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the Secretary of the Interior has prescribed and adopted ... and has submitted to me for approval the following amendments of the regulations
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by identifying regulations formulated or approved through a preceding institutional process and then establish the President's authority and role in formally proclaiming them.

shared_material.child_excerpt: REGULATIONS FOR PREVENTING COLLISIONS AT SEA  PART A.—PRELIMINARY AND DEFINITIONS
shared_material.parent_excerpt: AMENDMENT OF MIGRATORY BIRD TREATY ACT REGULATIONS ... I hereby prescribe the following amendments
shared_material.explanation: Each proclamation serves as a wrapper for an extensive, formally organized regulatory text rather than merely announcing a policy or observance.
